layout: 24 frames, four columns by six rows; idle4, gait8, bite4, pounce4, hurt2, death2

directions.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve game animation sprite sheet. Reference image is the approved moss wolf identity only: preserve gray-brown wolf fur, moss and fern tufts, amber eyes, pale muzzle, pointed ears and bushy tail. Create exactly TWENTY FOUR complete sprites of this SAME wolf, ALL facing SOUTH (screen down), seen from the FRONT with both amber eyes and pale muzzle visible under the same three-quarter overhead RPG camera. Portrait sprite atlas, EXACTLY FOUR equal columns by SIX equal rows, one whole wolf per cell, strictly separated generous transparent margins, NO labels or grid lines. Read left to right each row. Row 1: four subtle idle poses, breathing ribcage, ear twitch, relaxed tail swish. Row 2: walking frames 1-4. Row 3: walking frames 5-8, completing ONE continuous natural quadruped gait with alternating diagonally paired paws, forelegs and hindlegs visibly changing joint angles, planted paws and transferring weight, small torso bob and trailing tail. Row 4: four bite poses: head draws back, jaws open, forward snap with visible teeth, head returns. Row 5: four pounce poses: rear haunches deeply crouched, hindlegs push and forelegs reach, airborne torso stretched with paws tucked, landing forelegs bend to absorb weight. Row 6: hit flinch, recovery from flinch, collapsing death pose, resting fallen wolf. Maintain constant wolf body length, head size, camera and upper-left lighting. Crisp richly shaded handcrafted pixel clusters and dark brown outline, same detailed pixel art as reference, NOT smooth vector, NOT 3D, no blur. Every sprite's hip/body center stays at the cell center horizontally, common baseline for ground contact, feet and tails fully visible. No baked ground shadow. Transparent RGBA background, alpha zero between sprites and inside gaps between legs. Same wolf, genuine articulated anatomy changes, not identical sprites simply shifted, not whole-image squashing.
